notes: HOW MANY ARRIVE PER PICK - the single strongest lever on what the water is made of, which is why all 19 of these are here rather than in config.js. The spawner spends its per-tick budget in CREATURES: a school pick buys a whole school and a shark pick buys one shark, so a roster of 6-14 schools made the arena 75-81% minnows by headcount at every point in a run and the big-body share FELL from 22% at level 10 to 7% at level 21. Only fish.group.max used to live in this file; every other school's numbers were whatever the tuner last saved, so editing config.js did nothing. Measured by npm run test:ramp.
